code_or_query:
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
plt.xkcd()
fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(8,5))
# cold box
ax.add_patch(plt.Rectangle((2,0.5), 3, 2, fill=False, linewidth=2))
ax.text(3.5,1.5,'cold box\n2.4x1.8x2.0m',ha='center',va='center',fontsize=8)
# door
ax.plot([2,2],[0.5,2.5],linewidth=3)
ax.text(1.7,1.5,'door+strip',rotation=90,va='center',fontsize=7)
# pads
for x in [2.2,3.4,4.8]:
    ax.add_patch(plt.Rectangle((x,0.2),0.3,0.3,fill=False))
ax.text(3.5,0.05,'6 precast pads',ha='center',fontsize=7)
# roof gantry 2 panels
ax.plot([1.8,5.2],[2.9,2.9],linewidth=2)
ax.plot([1.8,1.8],[2.5,2.9],linewidth=1)
ax.plot([5.2,5.2],[2.5,2.9],linewidth=1)
ax.add_patch(plt.Rectangle((2.2,2.9),1.4,0.4,fill=False))
ax.add_patch(plt.Rectangle((3.6,2.9),1.4,0.4,fill=False))
ax.text(3.5,3.5,'2 PV shade modules + vent gap',ha='center',fontsize=7)
# separate ground array 4 panels
ax.plot([6,8.5],[0.5,1.5],linewidth=2)
for i in range(4):
    ax.add_patch(plt.Rectangle((6.1+i*0.55,0.7),0.5,0.6,fill=False))
ax.text(7.2,0.2,'ground PV 4 modules own footings',ha='center',fontsize=7)
ax.set_xlim(0,9)
ax.set_ylim(0,4)
ax.set_aspect('equal')
ax.axis('off')
plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig('sketch.png')
